# AI Rankings

> An awards-only ranking of AI research institutions. It counts only orals, best papers (incl. outstanding papers), honorable mentions and test-of-time awards at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ACL, EMNLP. Regular acceptances score zero. Credit goes to the first and corresponding authors' institutions as printed on the paper at publication time.

Data snapshot: 2026-07-10. 6,476 honored papers, award events 2012 – 2026 (test-of-time awards cover work from 1987), 97.8% affiliation-resolved, 1,552 institutions. Built by Jingxuan Kang. Code MIT, dataset CC BY 4.0.

Scoring used in the tables below (the site defaults): Test of Time = 10, Best / Outstanding Paper = 8, Honorable Mention / Award Candidate = 3, Oral = 1. Each paper splits credit 50/50 between the first author's and the corresponding author's institutions (last author when no corresponding author is flagged); multiple affiliations split equally. The all-time lens credits the year the work was done. The present-day lens halves an award's weight every 5 years of the work's age (reference year 2026). Columns ToT/Best/HM/Oral count honored papers with any credit to that institution. On the live site every weight, filter and lens is adjustable.

## Pages

- [Interactive ranking](https://airankings.jingxuan.uk/): leaderboard, treemap, institution dossiers with people and award records
- [Directory view](https://airankings.jingxuan.uk/classic.html): CSRankings-style expandable table
- [Dataset JSON](https://airankings.jingxuan.uk/data.json): every honored paper with venue, years, award tier, authors and institution ids
- [Methodology and caveats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JingxuanKang/ai-rankings/master/README.md)
- [Source code](https://github.com/JingxuanKang/ai-rankings)
